name: Machiyuki Shiki
source:
A divorced career-woman in search of a partner. She publishes depressing anime works, working under the name “Saison”. Although successful and wealthy with a high-income, she's become desperate ever since her divorce, playing with men and having pointless one-night stands. While looking for a match, she meets the host Katsurou and discovers his creative talent.

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/05/24/sini/]official website[/url]]
